title: Microduck - intent level (mj_host --level2)
launch_hint: ./mj_host/run.sh launcher → a level-2 preset, or ogma_mjhost --level2 --graph <config>
description: The duck above Pollen's walking policy (mj_host/src/IntentAdapter.cpp): the brain senses body velocity, the IMU, the ToF and its own odometry, and publishes a twist intent (+ the head's fore-aft slide) and skill requests. The host also reads the loops' outputs and the arbiter's gains to set the heading reference, and reads CloudMap / BearingSeekLoop / MotionField state directly (stops, gaze, logging) -- those reads are not topics and are not drawn.

sources.name: intent
sources.description: the sensed body velocity in the walker's command units [vx vy vyaw], each unit-clamped

sources.name: imu
sources.description: projected gravity [g_x g_y g_z] + gyro [w_x w_y w_z]

sources.name: sense
sources.description: the walker's load slots: g_x, g_y, pitch/roll/yaw rate x0.3, accel x/y/z /20, sensed vx, vy, heading deviation from its 60 s average /pi, map TLE, ToF left/ahead/right/too-close (the seek gate frees the target's sector). Host flags PREPEND slots: --intent-fore-sense +1 (the head's fore-aft), --intent-range-sense +1 (seek range /2), --intent-mover-sense +2 (the chased mover's velocity), --intent-head-sense +2; the ★ configs carry 18

sources.name: place_in
sources.description: the map EPM's input: the dead-reckoned pose (4) + the depth form's columns (--place-form; 13 in the ★ configs)

sources.name: depth_in
sources.description: the 8x8 depth frame with its own mean removed (--place-form stacked only)

sources.name: tof_points
sources.description: one ToF cast, repeated between casts (12.5 Hz): [still, yaw, trunk_z, odom_x, odom_y, 64 x (x,y,z) levelled body frame, sensor origin (x,y,z), 64 x the empty zones' ray ends]; CloudMap and MotionField read it

sources.name: odom
sources.description: the dead-reckoned pose [x, y, yaw] in the odometry frame (BearingSeekLoop, SkillOutcomeLoop)

sources.name: vel_ego
sources.description: the body velocity [lateral, forward] in command units

sources.name: tof
sources.description: the ToF summary [left, ahead, right, too-close] for an avoidance loop

sources.name: progress
sources.description: the walk's progress error toward the place it is heading [error, valid] (--place-stall, which needs --sit-on-stall; §17.116 M1)

sources.name: traverse_in
sources.description: the traversal EPM's input [commanded forward speed, commanded turn, sensed forward speed], each in the walker's units and averaged over ~1 s, so only a block that lasts reads 'commanded, not moving' (--sit-on-stall / --sit-on-surprise; §17.114)

sinks.name: vx
sinks.description: forward velocity command, unit-scaled to the walker's range

sinks.name: head_fore
sinks.description: the head's fore-aft slide (--intent-head-translate F), the walker's fourth motor

sinks.name: neck_pitch
sinks.description: the head as walker motors (--intent-head F): neck pitch

reads.name: place
reads.description: the map EPM's token: winner = place id, TLE = map surprise (slot 11 of sense)

reads.name: thing
reads.description: the thing EPM's token, logged

reads.name: thing_kind
reads.description: the thing-kind EPM's token, logged

reads.name: play_bearing
reads.description: the play loop's bearing: the heading reference when play wins

reads.name: seek_bearing
reads.description: the seek loop's bearing: the heading reference when seek (arbiter.gain.vision) wins

reads.name: avoid_bearing
reads.description: an avoidance loop's bearing: the reference when arbiter.gain.klino wins

reads.name: gain_play
reads.description: the arbiter's gate on the play loop

reads.name: gain_vision
reads.description: the arbiter's gate on the seek loop

reads.name: gain_klino
reads.description: the arbiter's gate on an avoidance loop

reads.name: seek_value
reads.description: the seek loop's need: arrival detection (need -> 0 at range < 0.3 m)

reads.name: seek_range
reads.description: the seek target's range: the range sense and arrival

reads.name: skill
reads.description: a skill request [id, 1] on one tick: the host runs Pollen's kick / peck

reads.name: outcome
reads.description: the outcome loop's record (node, prediction, observation, surprise), logged

reads.name: outcome_need
reads.description: the outcome loop's renewed target [need, x, y]: the host's thing bearing

reads.name: look_gain
reads.description: the arbiter's gain for the look: above 0.5 the host starts a stop, at or below it ends one the look began (--stop-by-look; §17.112)

reads.name: look
reads.description: the look loop's value [need, prediction, in a stop, realized, predicted]: logged

reads.name: look_commit
reads.description: the look loop's commitment to a stop it took [committed]: logged with the look's gain

reads.name: traverse
reads.description: the traversal EPM over traverse_in: its TLE against its running mean (--sit-on-surprise), or its input's sensed-against-commanded progress (--sit-on-stall, the ★ stacks), decides when the duck sits (§17.114)

reads.name: thing_belief
reads.description: ThingBelief's [presence, confirming, refuting, since, have] for the seek target: logged

reads.name: ambush
reads.description: the stalk loop's [have, x, y, need, waiting]: logged while it has a passing place

reads.name: mover_pos
reads.description: the seek loop's confirmed mover sighting [x/2, y/2]: logged once per sighting, with the motion map's node

reads.name: motion_map
reads.description: the motion map EPM over mover sightings: its winner and node count are logged with each sighting

events.name: reset
events.description: fired when the recovery harness stands the body back up
